releases.title: Shared memory and approved desktop actions
notes: Phone and desktop conversations share an encrypted desktop archive with bounded sync, deletion tombstones and local phone caching.
An idle conversation editor preserves concise context for older chats while leaving the original turns encrypted and intact.
Windows Search result selection, named accessibility controls and local OCR provide approved actions in selected apps.
Paired Android requests can authorize a single web turn or explicitly enable web access until /web off.
The optional Ming Image workflow plans website assets, renders locally while the main brain rests and restores it before site construction.
An Atlas-branded Windows setup verifies prerequisites and creates a first-time Companion install without manual Python setup.

releases.title: Atlas operates across desktop and phone
notes: The amber companion adds a local first-run model chooser, with hardware fit estimates, explicit download consent and integrity checks.
Studio gains selected Windows control guidance, engineering missions with chosen tests, output watches, mid-plan changes, and honest project checkpoints.
Bounded OBS and Blender adapters, expiring phone conversation handoff, and encrypted Pocket Projects extend the approved desktop-to-phone workflow.
Smart Roam uses a private coarse layout scan to avoid busy screen areas. Quiet visuals pauses continuous effects while retaining deliberate roaming.

releases.title: Pocket Tools display fix
notes: Android Pocket Tools now paints its saved tool and keeps its native controls visible on affected phones.
A real paired Studio tool was downloaded, edited and reopened on a OnePlus 15. Its phone-side edit persisted.
The desktop companion behavior is unchanged; this signed desktop archive aligns the source, version and release documentation.

releases.title: A companion across desktop and phone
notes: The companion can move across both displays. Speech subtly favors the display where Atlas is standing.
Studio tools can be shared explicitly to paired Android devices and saved there for offline use.
An authenticated PC starter can launch the companion from Android while Windows is awake and signed in.
Android adds local alarms in Atlas's voice, timers and encrypted notes with phone-side approval.
